description: Nearest-preference velocity triplet hinge from FP2 §4.4 Eq. (8): each sample compares its predicted velocity with its target and the predicted velocity at its nearest other preference, then applies a per-sample hinge. Equal-distance ties use the first minimizer returned by argmin. The standalone callable implements only L_triplet; compose λ_tri from Eq. (6) externally. The velocity target is x - z_0 (Eq. (7)); the default margin 1.0 follows the official repository contrastive_temperature (fp2/models/flow.py:88-89, 113-114).

examples.title: Train vector velocity models with FP2 triplet regularization

name: FP2 triplet velocity regularizer

parameters.additional parameters: preferences and margin are the only accepted entries in **params; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because this objective has no indexed labels
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point predicted velocity shaped [B, ...] with positive dimensions and at least one non-batch dimension
parameters.margin: positive finite hinge coefficient λ in FP2 §4.4 Eq. (8), default 1.0 from official repository contrastive_temperature (fp2/models/flow.py:88-89, 113-114)
parameters.preferences: required floating-point tensor [B, P] with P > 0, on the prediction device; supplied normalized values determine nearest neighbors by Euclidean distance
parameters.reduction: none returns one triplet loss per sample, mean averages the batch, or sum totals it (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point target velocity with the same shape, dtype, and device as logits_or_prediction; FP2 uses x - z_0 in §4.4 Eq. (7)
